description: Immutable local parameter-sensitivity rung for the two-layer EBM benchmark. It contrasts equilibrium-only observations, where three parameter directions are structurally invisible, with transient held-out forcing histories that locally distinguish all four reference parameters.
rank_policy: Singular-value rank uses eps * max(matrix_shape) * largest_singular_value. Parameters are perturbed multiplicatively in log coordinates so all four sensitivity columns are dimensionless-parameter derivatives of temperature observations.
derivative_policy: Use centered finite differences in log-parameter coordinates at the declared step and half-step. Report the relative Frobenius disagreement as a numerical consistency diagnostic; no optimizer, posterior, prior, or fitted parameter estimate is produced.
interpretation_boundary: Full local sensitivity rank under the declared transient protocols is not global parameter identifiability, observational calibration, or evidence that the real climate system identifies these parameters.
